items.q: So he says, 'Jonny Hodges, I'd love to have' -- he said -- 'do you suppose he'd do that?' And I said I didn't know, that he'd have to call him.

ctx.x: So he says, "Jonny Hodges, I'd love to have" -- he said -- "do you suppose he'd do that?" And I said I didn't know, that he'd have to call him. And Ben, my whole life with Ben was just starting then, you know, I was around all the time.
Did you recommend Bill? Were you the one who recommended Bill?
